Default Prove-Up In Scd.
Off Calendar Feb-24-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Tony Vaughn.
James M. Dombroski, Esq. for Plaintiff: Perry Boussina, present, was sworn and examined.
After hearing the evidence presented, the Court rules in favor of the Plaintiff and against the Defaulted Defendants: Anadot Corporation and Larry Bell as follows:
Damages $38,600.00
Attorney's Fees $7,500.00
Costs $412.50 for a total of $46,512.50
Judgment signed in open court.
